environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with default container security context. Pod runs with NET_RAW and SYS_ADMIN capabilities available. Service is exposed via a basic Kubernetes ClusterIP service with an nginx ingress controller (no ModSecurity, no WAF). PostgreSQL database is accessible on the pod network with the app_user having SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all tables. No query-level firewall or pgBouncer query inspection enabled.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15, app_user has full DML on schema
